subject: Sign-on + equity top-up approval request — Senior Backend
messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Candidate: Andrew Sullivan — sign-on + equity refresh request

Hi Neha / Laura,

Quick summary on Andrew Sullivan (senior backend hire we sourced via HiredPartners): 10+ yrs infra at scale (ex-DataForge), strong systems background, target start date ~Dec 6. We extended the baseline (band) offer yesterday: 180k base / 30k bonus target / 0.6% equity (4-yr vest, 1-year cliff) + standard benefits.

Candidate emailed a counter this morning — they’ve received a competing offer with a larger sign-on and slightly higher equity. Andrew is requesting a one-time sign-on of $50,000 and an equity bump to 0.75% (equity refresh) to bridge. He noted relocation stipend not required.

Recruiting recommends approving a limited, one-time sign-on + small equity uplift to close quickly — he’s a high-lift hire for our infra roadmap. Need leadership/comp approval since the sign-on is out of band relative to the published comp band for Sr Backend.

Attachments: candidate counter (candidate_counter_20261102.eml), offer packet (neha_offer_packet_v3.pdf).

Requested: formal approval (amounts) and whether we mark as one-time exceptional grant (preferred). Also confirm whether Finance needs to sign off on payment terms.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Recruiter — Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Andrew Sullivan — sign-on + equity refresh request

Thanks Aditya — reviewing. A few quick data points:
- Band top for Sr Backend (US-west): base cap aligns with our offer; sign-on past $20k requires director approval per comp policy.
- Equity refresh to 0.75% would be above typical for this band, so needs exec/comp committee note.

Given candidate strength and timing, my initial lean is to approve a one-time sign-on to close (we can structure as 50% at start, 50% at 30 days) but reduce to $40k rather than $50k, and approve a 0.15% equity top-up (bringing total to 0.75% if you keep base 0.6%). That keeps us slightly under their ask on cash, but competitive overall.

If Vivek can greenlight, I’ll instruct Aditya to send the updated DocuSign and mark the grant as a one-time refresh with standard vesting. Finance — please note we’ll need a one-off payment schedule.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP, Engineering Recruiting Operations
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T12:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Andrew Sullivan — sign-on + equity refresh request

Approve with modification. I support Neha’s approach with the following firm approvals:
- One-time sign-on: $40,000 (pay schedule: 50% on first payroll after start, 50% 30 days after start).
- Equity: one-time refresh grant equivalent to 0.15% (4-year vest schedule, accelerates pro rata on termination only per policy).

This will be marked as an exception and logged under HC-2026-042. Please state in the offer that this is a one-time exceptional grant tied to this offer only. No permanent band change.

Aditya: you have clearance to send the updated offer and DocuSign. Neha, loop Finance for payment scheduling; Marissa can coordinate with comp & legal on the grant paperwork.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director of Engineering (Hiring Lead)
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Sullivan <andrew.sullivan@tideview.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, kate@hiredpartners.com
Date: 2026-11-02T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Updated offer — Redwood Inference (Senior Backend)

Andrew — great speaking earlier. Below is the updated offer summary; see attached PDF and DocuSign link.

Summary (final):
- Base salary: $180,000
- Target bonus: $30,000 (10% target)
- Equity: 0.60% base + 0.15% one-time exceptional refresh (total 0.75%), 4-yr vest, 1-yr cliff
- One-time sign-on: $40,000 (50% at first payroll after start, remainder 30 days after start)
- Start date: target Dec 6, flexible by two weeks

This grant and sign-on are approved as a one-time exception and do not indicate a permanent change to banding. Please review the full offer packet (attached) and complete DocuSign at the link below to accept. Once you sign, team will finalize comp paperwork.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/na1/documents/ABC123-def456
Attachments: neha_offer_packet_v3.pdf

If you have any questions about the vesting schedule or payment timing, reply and I’ll confirm. Looking forward to having you.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
VP, Engineering Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Andrew Sullivan <andrew.sullivan@tideview.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: kate@hiredpartners.com
Date: 2026-11-03T08:09:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated offer — Redwood Inference (Senior Backend)

Thanks Neha — I appreciate the quick turnaround and the updated package. A couple quick clarifying questions before I sign: 
1) Vesting cadence: is the 0.15% refresh on the exact same 4-year schedule starting at Day 1, or will it have a different vest start date?
2) Sign-on payment: will the first tranche hit on my first payroll day (I’m starting Dec 6) or is there any processing window I should expect?

If those are standard, I’m ready to proceed. Looking forward to joining.

—Andrew
Andrew Sullivan
Senior Backend Engineer
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Sullivan <andrew.sullivan@tideview.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated offer — Redwood Inference (Senior Backend)

Thanks Andrew — quick answers: 
1) The 0.15% refresh will vest on the standard 4-year schedule with a 1-year cliff starting at your official start date (Dec 6). It will be included on the same grant paperwork as the base equity (not a separate delayed start).
2) Sign-on payment: first tranche will be included in your first payroll run after your start date (typically within 7 business days). The second tranche will be paid ~30 days after start. Finance has been briefed and will route any one-off payroll exceptions if needed.

Please sign the DocuSign when ready and we’ll kick off onboarding. Welcome aboard.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
VP, Engineering Recruiting Operations
Redwood Inference
